results.title: Mayasabha: The Hall of Illusion
results.overview: In a Mumbai theater, a producer, his son, and two intruders clash during one night over hidden treasure. As they search for gold, deception grows, secrets emerge, and past wounds resurface.

results.title: Dhanushkodiyilekku
results.overview: The starkly different lives of two families intertwine across decades of shifting history. While one group barely survived the catastrophic 1964 Dhanushkodi cyclone, the other has only ever known immense wealth.

results.title: Calling You
results.overview: After a middle-aged father falls mysteriously into a coma that transports him to an idealised version of his past, his daughter must do all things necessary to rescue him from an eternal trap.

results.title: Warak Areesh
results.overview: A cautious woman, hindered by a language barrier, struggles to connect with her grandmother but discovers a bond through food and tradition.

results.title: We Shall Live Together
results.overview: Roko Markovina, a former socialist and unionist politician from the city of Mostar in Herzegovina, reflects on the situation in Croatia and Bosnia during wartime and about the fruitless efforts that he and his wife went through to get back their home that had been taken away from them by nationalist forces who exiled them from it.

results.title: The Colour of My Heart
results.overview: Zia Mohyeddin, Pakistan's most venerated actor, devotes his final years to resurrecting interest in Urdu poetry and passing it on to a new generation of South Asians.

results.title: La Prona
results.overview: Elena, a fisherwoman from the Empordà region in Catalonia (Spain), struggles to keep alive the craft inherited from her family, but it becomes harder every day, and her livelihood risks disappearing.

results.title: The Second Assignment
results.overview: A film student in the midst of a moral crisis struggles to come up with a concept for his next short film.

results.title: Fortune House
results.overview: A desperate immigrant delivery driver stumbles into a mahjong parlor run by three demons, where he enters a demon’s deal: win the game, and they will grant him a green card.

results.title: The Sacrifice
results.overview: In a brutal dystopian society, a new life can only be created by sacrificing another. In the final hours before the birth, Lucas must secure his child's future - but does he have what it takes?

results.title: A Sweetness from Nowhere
results.overview: Filmmaker Ester Martin Bergsmark interrogates their response to a transphobic slur hurled at them following their move to Berlin. Exploring the root of violence and its nature, this is a powerful meditation on the trans experience and a treatise on how to move forward from fear.

results.title: Kill. Bury. Print.
results.overview: When the McCurtain Gazette, a small family-run newspaper, begins reporting on alleged sex, drugs, and violence within the county sheriff's office, they find themselves the target of the sheriff's retaliation. Tensions escalate when the paper obtains a secret recording revealing the sheriff and local officials allegedly discussing having the family killed, turning a local investigation into international news.

results.title: Call Me Queen
results.overview: The film depicts a friendship between an Irish journalist in Kenya and a Rwandan woman, who pair up to combat the AIDS crisis in the 1990s.

results.overview: The world has ended but we haven't got the news yet. Moved by a desire for revenge, a filmmaker remembers some of the images he's posted on Twitter over the years. What he'll learn on the way —nothing— will chage him forever.

results.title: Penguin
results.overview: Returning from Antarctica, a man brings his partner a rare gift. The gift causes a shift in their relationship, which is difficult to cope with. Has the man changed, or is it the woman who suddenly sees him differently?

results.title: Sunshine on the Road
results.overview: Unable to continue caring for their mother, who is suffering from dementia, a family embarks on one final trip together. During the journey, a long-buried family secret quietly surfaces, forever changing their understanding of one another.

results.title: Alienation
results.overview: A couple's strained relationship begins to unravel when they encounter a mysterious alien presence that challenges both their trust in each other and their grasp on reality.
